senate.description: Soil and water conservation district aid appropriation increase

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; local government aids; increasing the appropriation for soil and water conservation district aid; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 477A.23, subdivision 6.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 477A.23, subdivision 6, is amended to read:

Subd. 6.
Appropriation.
[-For aids payable in 2023 and 2024, $15,000,000 is appropriated in each year from the general fund to the commissioner of revenue to make the payments required under this section.-] For aids payable in 2025 [-and thereafter-], $12,000,000 is annually appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of revenue to make the payments required under this section.[+ For aids payable in 2026 and thereafter, $16,000,000 is annually appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of revenue to make the payments required under this section. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective for aids payable in 2026 and thereafter. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; local government aids; increasing the appropriation for soil and water conservation district aid; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 477A.23, subdivision 6.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 477A.23, subdivision 6, is amended to read:

Subd. 6.
Appropriation.
For aids payable in 2025 , $12,000,000 is annually appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of revenue to make the payments required under this section. For aids payable in 2026 and thereafter, $16,000,000 is annually appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of revenue to make the payments required under this section.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective for aids payable in 2026 and thereafter.
additions: For aids payable in 2026 and thereafter, $16,000,000 is annually appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of revenue to make the payments required under this section.
This section is effective for aids payable in 2026 and thereafter.
deletions: For aids payable in 2023 and 2024, $15,000,000 is appropriated in each year from the general fund to the commissioner of revenue to make the payments required under this section.
